data.name: Filberto
data.long_meaning: From the Latin filius, meaning 'son'. The name Filberto is a combination of 'filius' and 'berto', meaning 'bright, shining, new' and 'friend' respectively. In the Middle Ages, this name was popular among nobility and was often given to a firstborn son.
